critical_code_review_comments: routes_surveys.py is clean, single-file 335 lines, cleanly separated by survey type — good modularization.
MongoDB _id correctly excluded in every find() projection ({'_id': 0}).
generate_survey_data() is idempotent (delete_many before insert_many) — safe to re-run.
_question_analysis() correctly branches on type ('category' vs 'scale') and produces department breakdown + score distribution for scale questions.
MINOR: survey-analytics endpoint does not accept a 'segment' filter although data has segment field — inconsistency with other dashboards that accept segment. Non-blocking.
MINOR: pulse trend generation uses random.uniform inside gauss center — makes results non-deterministic across regenerations, but values are stored so reads are stable.
MINOR (from iter17, still open): server.py is 4132 lines — could be modularized like routes_surveys.py / routes_report_designer.py.
